audioCodecPriority.description: Choose up to three predefined codec priority options available for your region.

cdpEnabled.description: Enable/disable Cisco Discovery Protocol for local devices.

dect6825HandsetEmergencyNumber.description: Specify the destination number to be dialled from the DECT Handset top button when pressed.

lldpEnabled.description: Enable/disable Link Layer Discovery Protocol for local devices.

multicast.description: Specify up to 3 multicast group URLs each with a unique listening port.

qosEnabled.description: Enable/disable quality of service tagging of packets from the local device to the Webex Calling platform.

vlan.description: Specify a numeric Virtual LAN ID for devices.

webAccessEnabled.description: Enable/disable user level web access to the local device.

nightlyResyncEnabled.description: Enable/disable phone's default behavior regarding the nightly maintenance synchronization with the Webex Calling platform.
